about: Published prices per model id, USD per million tokens, as decimal strings (the discipline of config/model_parameters.json, spec F D-F29). The table selects nothing: .env names the models. pricing.url is the provider page the row was read from (https) and pricing.read_on the day it was read (YYYY-MM-DD); a row without both is refused, and so is a model the environment names without a row. batch_input and batch_output are the Batch API prices. quote holds the provider's own lines the figures were copied from.

claude-opus-5-5.quote: Model pricing row: "Claude Opus 5.5 | $4 / MTok | $5 / MTok | $8 / MTok | $0.20 / MTok<sup>2</sup> | $20 / MTok" (base input, 5m cache writes, 1h cache writes, cache hits, output). Batch: "The Batch API allows asynchronous processing of large volumes of requests with a 50% discount on both input and output tokens."; row "Claude Opus 5.5 | $2 / MTok | $10 / MTok". Long context: "Claude 4.6 and later models ... include the full 1M token context window at standard pricing." Thinking, https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-steering-and-cost, read 2026-10-04: "Tokens Claude uses while thinking (billed as output tokens)" and "`output_tokens` remains the inclusive, authoritative total used for billing."

gpt-6-astra.quote: Standard: "Short context input $10.00 | Short context cached input $1.00 | Short context output $50.00"; "Long context input $20.00 | Long context cached input $2.00 | Long context output $75.00"; Batch: "Short context input $5.00 | Short context cached input $0.50 | Short context output $25.00"; "Short context: ≤272K input tokens. Long context: >272K input tokens." Reasoning, https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/reasoning, read 2026-10-04: "While reasoning tokens are not visible via the API, they still occupy space in the model's context window and are billed as output tokens."
